8.5.18.3 Edge rising detection
[SWS_Efx_00384] Definition of API function Efx_EdgeRising_u8_u8 ⌈
Service Name
Efx_EdgeRising_u8_u8
Syntax
boolean Efx_EdgeRising_u8_u8 (
boolean Inp_Val,
boolean* Old_Val
)
Service ID [hex]
0xC7
Sync/Async
Synchronous
Reentrancy
Reentrant
Parameters (in)
Inp_Val
Actual value of the signal
Parameters (inout)
Old_Val
Pointer to the value of the signal from the last call
Parameters (out)
None
Return value
boolean
Returns TRUE when the signal has rising edge
Description
Returns TRUE when the signal has a rising edge, i.e. the signal was FALSE at the last call and
TRUE at the actual call of this routine
Available via
Efx.h
⌋
[SWS_Efx_00385] ⌈Return value = TRUE, If (*Old_Val == FALSE && Inp_Val ==
TRUE)
Return value = FALSE, otherwise.⌋
